headline: DBS survey finds nearly 90% of large firms adopting tokenized cash instruments
summary: A survey by DBS showed that nearly 90% of large enterprises are embracing tokenized cash for payments, with stablecoins leading at 63%, ahead of tokenized deposits and money market funds.
why: DBS is Southeast Asia's largest commercial bank, and its institutional enterprise surveys offer critical visibility into corporate treasury cash-management innovation.

impacts.name: Payments
impacts.why: Growing corporate treasury adoption of digital tokens speeds liquidity clearing and cross-border settlement.
